_notes: Fantasy points allowed (FPA) per game by opponent defence, used by shared/weekly-score.js matchupMultiplier.
positions  = league-average FPA per position (neutral matchup). Used when a team has no entry below.
historical = 3-year average FPA per team per position. Fill from a static export; never hand-type guesses.
current    = this season's FPA per team per position. Refresh weekly from https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/matchups/<qb|rb|wr|te|k>.php (table: team, fantasy pts allowed per game).
Blend: season_weight = min(1, weeks_played/8); effective = season_weight*current + (1-season_weight)*historical.
Team keys are Sleeper abbreviations (KC, SF, LAR, JAX, WSH …). Empty objects = factor stays neutral (1.0x) and the UI marks it as not wired.
